rationale: Three independent lenses (blind, edge-case, acceptance) reviewed the full removal diff (23 files, +425/-911). Two blocking findings: (1) the ZephyrSquad test-block deletion in test_user_settings.py accidentally removed two unrelated MS Teams tests, silently dropping regression coverage for an active feature; (2) the plan's own explicit test-first requirement to add a generic invalid-credential-type 422 test after deleting the ZephyrSquad-specific 410 tests was not implemented, leaving that behavior untested. All other aspects (tool deletion, catalog deregistration, deprecated-flag removal, DEPRECATED_CREDENTIAL_TYPES/validator removal, settings-service cleanup, Alembic migration correctness, out-of-scope isolation from Zephyr Scale) passed all three lenses cleanly. 2 minor/informational notes (destructive migration DELETE with no row-count logging; DB enum label convention) were reviewed and judged acceptable given the PO's explicit zero-prod-usage confirmation and no-backward-compatibility instruction — not blocking.

business_review.notes: Whole directory deleted, toolkit deregistered (5->4 tools), deprecated field removed from ToolMetadata/Tool with zero other consumers confirmed, matching tests deleted/updated.

business_review.notes: DEPRECATED_CREDENTIAL_TYPES mechanism, router call sites, settings.py/settings_tester.py references, and enum member all removed correctly. The plan's required generic invalid-credential-type test was missing at final-round time (CR-002).

business_review.criterion: Task 3 — Drop the DB enum label via sync_enum_values migration
business_review.notes: New migration correctly targets the single existing head, deletes leftover rows first, follows the exact established enum-sync pattern and label convention.
QA toolkit list updated; optional cosmetic items correctly left alone per plan guidance.
